facts.anchor: I heard the bell over the door chime and stopped sanding to listen.
facts.fact: Zak 听见门铃以为是 Roddie（放学时段），停下打磨去查看；父亲正在给客人表演魔术师套路。

facts.anchor: Dad had launched into his magician routine with someone, so I gave my hands a quick wash and went out to find Roddie looking confused by the punchline.
facts.fact: 他向 Dale 介绍 Roddie 与 Meg，提起隔壁的 Meg 时把父亲吓一跳。

facts.anchor: “Layaway is how people used to buy things in olden times,” I explained. “Like a loan, but you had to pay it off before you took your purchase home.”
facts.fact: Dale 记得的是「卖儿童玩具的店」——他为自己搞错而尴尬。

facts.anchor: “Oh. I get it now. That’s pretty funny,” he told Dale.
facts.fact: Roddie 吐槽「你以为你尴尬」，并说只是好奇来看看。

facts.anchor: “Dad, this is Roddie.” I reminded him that they’d met before and told him where, then mentioned Meg next door.
facts.fact: Zak 像上回那样先去把工具收进工作间（吸取教训）。

facts.anchor: “Not Debra. The toy store,” Dad said, chuckling and scratching the back of his head. He turned to Roddie. “How embarrassing—I thought she was selling toys for kids.”
facts.fact: 锁好柜子回来，父亲正在对 Roddie 讲「People can't buy it if they can't see it」——把货架往橱窗挪。

facts.anchor: “You think you’re embarrassed,” Roddie muttered out of the side of his mouth.
facts.fact: Roddie 靠口香糖机、父子翻老爷车杂志；Zak 借机跟 Meg 单独说笑。

facts.anchor: Better, I supposed. “Did your mom send you over for something?”
facts.fact: 章末是 Dented Hearts Club 成立：第一项议程「no social media stalking」，两人瓶口相碰。
